_comment: Issue #1096/#1119/#1128: a plain NORMAL-stance MOVE order pauses (unchanged) while the unit is State.FIGHTING, then, once the fight genuinely ends, either resumes toward its original destination or cancels outright -- Order.Guard.ENGAGED_FRACTION_ABOVE marks which moves opt into this, Unit._resolve_disengage_move_order() makes the call. Stages a sustained, evenly-matched melee (two 40-soldier Spearmen regiments) so the fight lasts long enough to redirect mid-fight: at tick 300, with the player heavily engaged, a plain move order is issued to a point just to the side of the clash. The order is accepted (order_guard shows ENGAGED_FRACTION_ABOVE) and holds while contact continues -- but around tick 332, once the unit's own engagement linger decays, the destination still sits inside the enemy's own footprint (it never moved far), so the order is cancelled outright (current_order drops to null) instead of marching off -- the unit falls back into the same fight within a couple of ticks rather than straying toward a destination the enemy still holds.
